text: CloudWay 24 offers generous and convenient baggage allowances tailored to each cabin class, ensuring a comfortable and seamless journey for all passengers.

- Class: CloudLux (First) | Number of Bags: 2 | Max Weight (per bag): 10 kg each | Maximum Dimensions (L x W x H): 55 x 40 x 23 cm
- Class: CloudElite (Business) | Number of Bags: 2 | Max Weight (per bag): 8 kg each | Maximum Dimensions (L x W x H): 55 x 40 x 23 cm
- Class: CloudComfort (Premium Economy) | Number of Bags: 1 | Max Weight (per bag): 8 kg | Maximum Dimensions (L x W x H): 55 x 40 x 23 cm
- Class: CloudSaver (Economy) | Number of Bags: 1 | Max Weight (per bag): 7 kg | Maximum Dimensions (L x W x H): 55 x 40 x 23 cm
In addition: 1 small personal item (laptop bag/handbag) per passenger is permitted.

Bags exceeding 158 cm (62 in) in total dimensions (L+W+H) or the permitted weight may incur excess baggage fees.
path: CloudWay 24 Baggage Allowance Policy > Checked Baggage Allowance

text:
- Excess Baggage: Can be pre-purchased at a discounted rate via the CloudWay24 app or website during booking or under "Manage My Flight."
- At Airport: Higher fees apply for additional or overweight baggage checked at the airport counter.
- SkyPoints 24 Members: Elite tier members may enjoy additional free allowance—check your SkyPoints 24 tier benefits.
path: CloudWay 24 Baggage Allowance Policy > Excess Baggage Policy

text:
- Sporting equipment and musical instruments accepted as part of checked baggage allowance; items exceeding size/weight limits may attract charges.
- Contact customer service for special arrangements or detailed advice.
path: CloudWay 24 Baggage Allowance Policy > Special Baggage

text:
- All baggage must be properly labeled with your name and contact information.
- Carry-on luggage must fit in the overhead bin or under the seat.
- Dangerous or prohibited items not allowed.
path: CloudWay 24 Baggage Allowance Policy > Important Guidelines

text: For the most up-to-date baggage rules and detailed FAQs, visit CloudWay24.com/Baggage (https://CloudWay24.com/Baggage) or check the "Baggage Policy" section in the CloudWay24 app.
